resources.string: The optional background-data control uses Android\u2019s Data Saver settings to restrict background traffic on metered networks. It does not create a VPN connection or send traffic to project servers.

Optional features \u2014 overlays, root or Shizuku actions and sharing \u2014 run only when you turn them on. You can withdraw consent by turning a feature off or uninstalling the app; this does not affect processing carried out before withdrawal. Uninstalling stops the app from collecting data on your device, but does not delete data already sent to Google. To request deletion of data the developer holds, email catsmoker.lab@gmail.com.

Settings and app state are kept in on-device storage only: theme, language, onboarding choices, launch counters, ad preferences, game library entries, Gaming Mode options (DNS choice, refresh rate, cleaner patterns, suspend lists), overlay and crosshair positions, game-config backups, diagnostic logs and crash records. Nothing in this list is uploaded to the developer \u2014 there is no backend to upload it to. Uninstalling the app, or clearing its data, deletes it.

Modifying game files may violate the terms of service of individual games and can lead to penalties such as restricted features or banned accounts. The developer is not responsible for account bans or any loss in third-party games. Use these features at your own risk.

The Application works without root for many features. Some optional system tweaks and file edits require Shizuku or root. Rooting or jailbreaking a device removes security restrictions and can expose it to malware, void warranties, break banking or payment apps, or stop the app from working. Enable these features only if you understand and accept that risk. Features that change system settings (resolution, refresh rate, animation scales, DNS, audio, dexopt compilation) act on your instruction. The app backs up game configs before writing where it can, but you accept the risk of instability, boot problems or data loss. You can revert changes or uninstall the app at any time.
